How it works

Three steps.

  1. Upload up to 10 files

    Receipt photos (JPG, PNG, HEIC), PDFs, and bank or card exports (CSV, Excel, Numbers).

  2. Pick a date range

    This month, last month, a custom range or all dates.

  3. Review and export

    Fix anything marked “Check this,” then export your spreadsheet.

FAQ

Common questions.

What files can I upload?
Up to 10 at a time: receipt photos (JPG, PNG, HEIC), PDFs, and bank or credit card exports as CSV, Excel or Numbers files.
Can I use my own categories?
Yes. Enter your own, separated by commas, or use the built-in list: Meals, Travel, Lodging, Office Supplies, Software, Utilities, Professional Services, Marketing, Equipment and Other.
Are my receipts stored?
No. Your files are processed to produce your result and discarded — nothing is stored. See the Privacy Policy.
What does it cost?
Expense Organizer is part of Workblox Business. You pick your tools and pay by how many: $25/mo for 1–3 tools, $40/mo for 4–7 tools, or $75/mo for 8–16 tools, with a 7-day free trial.
